missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. The neuter noun 'лечение' is nominative as the subject of 'оказалось'. The predicate 'долгим' stands in the instrumental, as is normal after this verb.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. As an inanimate neuter, 'лечение' keeps the same form in the accusative. It is the direct object of 'назначил', and 'новое' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after без. The preposition 'без' takes the genitive, giving the neuter form 'лечения'. 'Правильного' agrees in the genitive, warning of the consequence.
Strategic focus: Dative after благодаря. The preposition 'благодаря' governs the dative, so 'лечению' is dative. The clause credits the recovery to the treatment.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after доволен. The short adjective 'довольны' requires the instrumental, giving 'лечением'. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. After 'в' the neuter noun takes the prepositional form 'лечении'. The phrase 'нет смысла' uses the genitive for absence, judging the treatment pointless.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after о. The preposition 'о' takes the prepositional form 'лечении'. 'Много' adds quantity to the reading, a useful pattern for research and study.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with genitive objects. 'Лечение' is the nominative subject of 'требует', a verb that governs the genitive, giving 'времени и терпения'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Лечения' is genitive, specifying methods of treatment. The quantity word 'несколько' puts 'методов' in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative complement. 'Лечение' is nominative as the subject of 'помогает', a verb that takes the dative, giving 'многим людям'.
